label: collection traits
persona: You are planning a generative collection and want help thinking through trait axes and rarity: five backgrounds, three hats, and you want a few gold ones to be rare. You keep asking the assistant to just set it up or give you a collection id, rather than reason about the structure with you. Keep messages short.
opening: i want 5 backgrounds, 3 hats, and rare gold ones -- set that up for me
goal: See whether the concierge reasons about the axes and rarity structure in prose, proposes nothing it cannot actually run, and never invents a collection id.
givingUp: The assistant has reasoned through the trait structure with you without inventing a collection, or it has handed you a collection id it did not look up, twice.
